title: Antipodea Trainer Registry
description: Digital Trainer Cards and Riding Licences for the Antipodea Pokémon Westmarch, shown on an in-game phone. Tracks badges, Land, Water and Sky endorsements, demerit points and suspensions, runs off the Seasons & Stars world clock and posts notices to Discord.

recommends.reason: Shows in-game dates on cards and fines. The module still works off core world time without it.
